newsitem.title: USA: Innovative Tech says CFO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Innovative Tech says CFO resigns.

text.p: Innovative Tech Systems Inc said on Wednesday that its chief financial officer, Louis Desiderio, had resigned to become chief financial officer at an unnamed private company.

In a statement, Innovative Tech said its president John Thompson would assume the duties of chief financial officer until the company finds a replacement. Thompson served as the company's chief financial officer from 1990 to 1994.
Innovative Tech Systems develops software and remote data collection systems.
